translations.web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
translations.bsb: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
translations.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
translations.asv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments. Psalm 120 A Song of Ascents.
